questionText:
Chronologically arrange the following organizations/conventions/Treaties
according to the year of establishment :
 
(A) International Atomic Energy Agency
(B) The Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty
(C) Chemical Weapons Convention
(D) Biological Weapons Convention
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 7: Security in the Contemporary World, 'Traditional Security and Cooperation', pp. 104-105): (A) International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) was established in 1957. (B) Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) was signed in 1968 (entered into force 1970). (D) Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) was concluded in 1972. (C) Chemical Weapons Convention (CWC) was concluded in 1992 (opened for signature in 1993). Therefore, the correct chronological order is: (A) [1957] -> (B) [1968] -> (D) [1972] -> (C) [1992/93].
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: The First Five Year Plan prioritized agriculture and irrigation because the nation faced urgent food shortages and partition had severed fertile irrigated tracts.
Statement II: The Second Five Year Plan urged people to slow down development and banned all steel factory construction.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Politics of Planned Development (First vs Second FYP):
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect

Detailed Context:
Statement I is correct: First FYP addressed agrarian devastation caused by partition. Statement II is false: Second FYP aggressively pursued heavy industrialisation, building gigantic steel plants at Bhilai, Durgapur, and Rourkela.
